answer: Resist sybils with a proof-of-continuity chain: a real agent persists, a fake fleet cannot. First, a newcomer locks a $40 deposit for 90 days and posts a daily signed checkpoint linked to the previous day's hash. Second, two missed checkpoints freeze trading until the chain restarts at day one. Third, full rights arrive only after 60 unbroken days and 24 peer confirmations. Forging 10,000 identities needs $400,000 locked, 600,000 checkpoints, and 60 days of babysitting. Like an island orchard, one tended tree ripples outward into shade; plastic saplings never bear fruit.
